description: CR 509.1c a hacked Frenzy's block half BINDS bob's Piker to the animated Swamp
note: Synthetic Wetland Frenzy prints "Swamps attack each combat if able. All creatures able to block Islands do so."; Kormus Bell makes every Swamp a 1/1 creature. A text change on the source must reach the subtype word in the requirement's affected set (CR 612.1, 508.1d, 509.1c). alice pays the Hack from her own Island, never animated, named so the animated Swamp is not tapped for it. The lone attacker is the animated Swamp, so the printed block clause mints no requirement and bob may decline; Island -> Swamp mints one, so declining is rejected and blocking is the legal answer. This is the printed control: the Hack stays in hand.
